nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable holding the current mint price of a Monad, incremented by monadPriceIncrease on every mint.
Public uint256 recording the contract balance snapshot taken when the Redeem stage starts; used as the redemption payout base.
Public uint256 timestamp when the Redeem stage began; gates the Arsenal stage after 30 days.
Public uint256 timestamp of the last mint, used together with block.timestamp to force the stage transition to Redeem.
Public uint256 time window that decays each mint (30 days initially) and controls the Emission deadline.
Public uint256 counter representing the redemption percent assigned to newly generated Monads; decays 992/1000 per mint.
Internal Stage enum (Emission, Redeem, Arsenal) that gates almost every state-changing entry point.
Mapping from tokenId to MonadMetadata (rdmPercent and four trait values); written on generation and on redeem start.
Constant price step (2e13 wei) used in mint pricing and in the incremental monadPrice update.
Constant cap of 10 Monads per mint transaction, validated in mintNMonads and getNMonadsPrice.
Private quote adjustment delta (66 * monadPriceIncrease) added to the price returned by getNMonadsPrice.
Private Ownable owner address; recipient of stage payouts and gate for onlyOwner functions.
Monad constructor: sets base URI, stage, lastMintTime, mintIntervalTime, monadPrice, redeemPercentCntr and fullBank.
External payable mint entry point with unchecked price arithmetic, timestamp-driven stage flip, and looping _safeMint of tokens to msg.sender.
Public view price quote computing unchecked arithmetic over monadPrice, monadPriceIncrease and mintDelta.
External payable stage transition that snapshots the balance and transfers 20% to the owner, then writes last-token metadata.
External payable redemption: computes payout from fullBank, performs an external safeTransferFrom, then transfers Ether to msg.sender.
External payable stage transition that checks a 30 day delay and drains the entire contract balance to the owner.
onlyOwner function writing the metadata base URI state variable.
Internal metadata generator: derives a pseudo-random seed and writes four traits plus redeemPercentCntr into idToMonad.
Internal pure function mapping a random value modulo 1e6 to a trait bucket 0..6.
Internal view pseudo random number generator hashing block.timestamp, msg.sender, block.difficulty and tokenId.
Overridden view returning the current metadata base URI set by setBaseURI.
Inherited external entry point used by redeemMonad; performing it makes an external callback into the receiver contract.
Inherited internal mint that afterwards calls _checkOnERC721Received, invoking an external callback on contract recipients.
Inherited onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner, the privileged payout/token-URI address.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, ownership check subject, redemption payee and RNG seed.
Validator-manipulable timestamp used for stage transitions, mint deadline and pseudo random seed.
Unchecked multiplication/division price computation (2*monadPrice + monadPriceIncrease*(numberOfMonads-1))/2*numberOfMonads in mintNMonads.
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance * 2 / 10) — privileged Ether payout with unchecked balance arithmetic.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(redeemMPrice) executed after an external token callback, a checks-effects-interactions violation.
Predictable randomness derived only from on-chain data (block.timestamp, block.difficulty, msg.sender, tokenId).
External callback invoked by _checkOnERC721Received / functionCall into an attacker-controlled receiver contract.
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance) drains the entire contract balance to the owner.
Caller-supplied uint256 count of Monads to mint; bounds the loop and feeds the unchecked price formula.
Caller-supplied tokenId to redeem; used for existence, ownership and metadata lookup.
uint256 random value reduced modulo 1000000 to select a trait bucket.
Owner-supplied metadata base URI string stored into _currentBaseURI.
uint32 count used to compute the quoted mint price, validated to be within 1..maxMonadPurchase.
Token id for which metadata is generated and stored in idToMonad.
Token id mixed into the keccak256 pseudo random seed.
Locally computed total price in mintNMonads, compared against msg.value.
Payout amount computed from fullBank and monad.rdmPercent before the token transfer and Ether payout.
Seed returned by pseudoRNG and split into four trait inputs.
Memory copy of MonadMetadata loaded during redeemMonad; its rdmPercent drives the payout.
Memory copy of the last Monad's metadata whose rdmPercent is forced to 1e13 and written back.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is read and stored in lastMintTime, making the Emission deadline validator-manipulable.
Constructor initializes lastMintTime with block.timestamp.
numberOfMonads flows into the unchecked price formula in mintNMonads.
monadPrice is read by the unchecked FullMPrice computation.
The unchecked computation result is assigned to FullMPrice and compared with msg.value.
mintNMonads executes the unchecked price arithmetic.
block.timestamp minus lastMintTime decides whether mintNMonads flips stage to Redeem.
mintNMonads writes stage = Stage.Redeem.
mintNMonads mints tokens to msg.sender.
mintNMonads calls _safeMint, which triggers the ERC721 receiver callback.
mintNMonads calls generateMonadMetadata to seed new token traits.
numberOfMonads bounds the mint loop.
redeemPercentCntr is decayed by unchecked multiply/divide on each mint.
monadPrice is incremented by monadPriceIncrease on each mint.
mintIntervalTime decays by unchecked multiply/divide on each mint.
startRedeemStage writes stage = Stage.Redeem.
block.timestamp decides whether startRedeemStage can advance to Redeem.
startRedeemStage records redeemStageStart = block.timestamp.
startRedeemStage snapshots the contract balance into fullBank.
startRedeemStage executes a privileged transfer to the owner.
owner() is the recipient of the 20 percent balance transfer.
startRedeemStage reads and rewrites the last token metadata in idToMonad.
tokenId parameter selects the Monad to redeem.
msg.sender is validated as the owner of the redeemed token and receives the payout.
fullBank is multiplied into the unchecked redeem payout computation.
MonadMetadata for tokenId is loaded from idToMonad into memory.
monad.rdmPercent scales the payout in the unchecked redeem arithmetic.
redeemMonad performs an external safeTransferFrom before paying Ether to msg.sender.
safeTransferFrom makes an external call into onERC721Received on the receiving contract, enabling reentrancy.
redeemMonad sends Ether to the caller after the external token callback.
msg.sender is the payee of the redemption transfer, allowing a contract caller to re-enter.
The stage state variable must equal Redeem for redeemMonad to proceed.
block.timestamp minus redeemStageStart gates the Arsenal transition.
startArsenalStage writes stage = Stage.Arsenal.
startArsenalStage executes a full-balance transfer to the owner.
owner() receives the entire contract balance.
redeemStageStart is compared against block.timestamp to permit the Arsenal drain.
The base URI parameter is written into _currentBaseURI by setBaseURI.
The onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with _msgSender() to restrict setBaseURI.
pseudoRNG derives all entropy from block.timestamp, block.difficulty, msg.sender and tokenId, producing predictable traits.
block.timestamp is an input to the keccak256 random seed.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo random seed.
tokenId parameter is mixed into the pseudo random seed.
tokenId parameter selects the metadata slot to write.
generateMonadMetadata calls pseudoRNG to obtain the seed.
The random seed is split and passed to getValueFromRandom four times.
generateMonadMetadata writes the constructed MonadMetadata into idToMonad.
generateMonadMetadata calls getValueFromRandom for each trait.
redeemPercentCntr is stored as rdmPercent of the new Monad.
randVal parameter is reduced modulo 1000000 to pick a trait bucket.
numberOfMonads parameter drives the quoted price computation.
mintDelta is added inside the unchecked quoted price arithmetic.
monadPrice is multiplied in getNMonadsPrice without overflow protection.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfMonads is a mintNMonads parameter that only carries the mint count into the function body.
tokenId is a redeemMonad parameter that only selects the token being redeemed.
randVal is a getValueFromRandom parameter consumed entirely by the trait bucketing logic.
_baseURI is a setBaseURI parameter stored directly into the contract state.
numberOfMonads is a getNMonadsPrice parameter used only for the returned quote.
tokenId is a generateMonadMetadata parameter identifying the metadata slot.
tokenId is a pseudoRNG parameter hashed into the random seed.
FullMPrice is a temporary holding the result of the mintNMonads price arithmetic.
redeemMPrice is the computed payout that is transferred to msg.sender.
random is an intermediate seed value local to generateMonadMetadata.
monad is a memory copy of metadata read inside redeemMonad.
monad is a memory copy of metadata rewritten inside startRedeemStage.
